_about: Prompts for the recorded animal calls and sound effects, generated once with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API by tools/gen-sounds.js. Ids match the calls in js/band.js (CALLS). Every sound also has a synthesised fallback, so the app works if a file is missing.
common: close-up, isolated, no music, no speech, no background noise
